editor.renderWhitespace.description: Spaces and tabs drawn as dots and arrows (Visual Studio's View White Space, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+W): all of them, only trailing ones, all but single spaces between words, only in the selection, or none.

editor.wordWrap.description: Long lines wrap at the window's edge instead of scrolling (Visual Studio's Word Wrap, Ctrl+E, Ctrl+W).

editor.lineNumbers.description: Line numbers in the margin: the line's own, its distance from the caret, or none.

editor.minimap.description: The map of the document beside the scrollbar (never on a phone).

editor.stickyScroll.description: The scopes the top line is in (namespace, class, function) stay at the top while you scroll, as in Visual Studio 2022.

editor.fontSize.description: The code font's size in pixels; 0 follows the theme (larger on a phone). Ctrl+Shift+. and Ctrl+Shift+, zoom for a while without changing it.

editor.bracketPairColorization.description: Each pair of brackets in its own color. Off by default: color in code carries a token's kind.
